tagline: A leading global provider of performance chemicals for refrigeration, coatings, plastics, and specialty applications.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary growth driver for Chemours, supported by the regulatory transition toward low-global-warming-potential refrigerants and increased demand in the air conditioning sector.

kpis.name: Thermal Specialized Solutions Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of refrigerants, thermal management solutions, and other specialized products.
kpis.description: Revenue increased due to a 5% price increase and an 8% volume growth, particularly for Opteon™ refrigerants.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by demand and pricing.

kpis.short: Marge Adjusted EBITDA Thermal Specialized Solutions
kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin Thermal Specialized Solutions
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the Thermal Specialized Solutions segment before certain financial and exceptional items.
kpis.description: Margin improved by 100 basis points, reflecting better operational performance due to higher Opteon product volumes and price increases.
kpis.signal: Improved profitability driven by better cost and pricing management.

kpis.name: Titanium Technologies Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the production and sale of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigments.
kpis.description: This segment is a global leader in TiO2 production, used for whiteness and opacity. The decline is attributable to a 6% price decrease and a 1% volume reduction.
kpis.signal: Decline due to lower prices and volumes, partially offset by favorable foreign exchange movements.

kpis.name: Advanced Performance Materials Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of polymers and advanced materials with unique properties.
kpis.description: This segment supplies high-performance materials for demanding applications, including fluoropolymer resins and advanced polymers.
kpis.signal: Detailed data not available in the 2025 10-K.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin Titanium Technologies
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the Titanium Technologies segment before financial and exceptional items.
kpis.description: Margin declined by 600 basis points, reflecting lower prices, reduced production, and operational disruption costs of approximately $41 million.
kpis.signal: Significant contraction due to price reductions, cost absorption, and operational disruptions.

kpis.name: Provision for Income Taxes
kpis.explanation: Amount of income taxes recorded by the company.
kpis.description: The tax provision increased in 2025, primarily due to the establishment of a $181 million valuation allowance against federal, foreign, and state deferred tax assets, partially offset by an $81 million tax benefit related to environmental and litigation reserves.
kpis.signal: Significant increase due to a valuation allowance against deferred tax assets.

kpis.name: Net Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Net cost of interest paid on the company's debt.
kpis.description: Interest expense increased by $6 million (2%), rising from $263 million to $269 million, due to higher interest rates on variable-rate debt and an increase in principal following the issuance of the 2033 Notes in November 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in interest expense due to higher rates and increased debt principal.

kpis.short: Gain sur vente du site de Taiwan
kpis.name: Gain on Sale of Taiwan Site
kpis.explanation: Proceeds received from the sale of land at the Kuan Yin, Taiwan site.
kpis.description: Gain recognized in January 2026 from the sale of ten land parcels at the Kuan Yin, Taiwan site, at a total purchase price of approximately $7 million, contributing to other net income.
kpis.signal: Non-recurring gain related to the disposal of real estate assets.

risks.title: Debt Default and Refinancing Risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions an amendment to the credit agreement (Fourth Amendment) extending the maturity of a $1.05 billion loan, indicating active debt management. The 2% increase in interest expense and a $5 million loss on debt extinguishment suggest pressure on capital.

risks.title: Litigation and Regulatory Settlement Impact
risks.score_rationale: Litigation charges related to an agreement with the State of New Jersey are mentioned. The language used to describe these charges and their financial impact is direct and quantified in the risk and reserves sections.

risks.title: Operational Disruption and Supply Chain
risks.score_rationale: An operational disruption led to $41 million in costs for the Titanium Technologies segment. This highlights the vulnerability of key operations and the supply chain.

risks.title: Raw Material Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: A 6% price decline in the Titanium Technologies segment is cited as a major concern. Raw material and input costs are mentioned as significant impacting factors.

ai_positioning.summary: Chemours does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, business segments, and regulatory matters.
